evidence: Carries the Validation label and refactors Chainstate::ConnectBlock and block-validation interfaces in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Separating the check-only validation path into a dedicated TestConnectBlock clarifies CBlockIndex mutability guarantees and removes the fJustCheck parameter from the core ConnectBlock interface. This is a worthwhile internal cleanup to make validation code safer to reason about and test, but it does not change consensus rules or validation behavior.
